description: URBANopt DES combines district-energy results from OpenStudio and EnergyPlus with Modelica Buildings Library results. The Python package extends URBANopt with detailed thermal and energy performance analysis. The provider is URBANopt DES contributors. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The README states BSD-3-Clause. Dependent simulation engines and libraries retain their own terms. Limitations: The metadata describe the authors’ work; they do not independently establish accuracy, completeness or reproducibility. For simulation it supports processing and comparing building and district-system energy results. Related resources: This is an explicitly documented extension of model-urbanopt-sdk and uses platform-openstudio results. The parent record does not name this separate DES package.
